newsitem.title: UK: BMW to build new Rover engine plant in UK.
newsitem.headline: BMW to build new Rover engine plant in UK.

text.p: German automotive giant BMW's Rover unit is to build a 400 million pounds ($666.2 million) plant to produce the new generation NG4 engine at Hams Hill in the West Midlands of Britain, the British government announced on Friday.

The new plant will safeguard around 1,500 jobs at Rover and around 5,000 more in the automotive components supply industry. A package of Government and local assistance helped secure the project, the Department of Trade said in a statement.

The DTI said agreement was reached last night at a meeting in between British trade secretary Ian Lang, BMW Group Chairman Bernd Pischetsrieder and Rover Chief Executive and BMW Group Board member Dr Walter Hasselkus.
"I am delighted that we have won this prestigious project against stiff competition. It is magnificent news for Britain," Lang said in a statement.
"I welcome the commitment BMW Group is making to investment in Rover's long term future. This is a very welcome mark of confidence in Rover's future potential," he added.
The plant will produce engines for both Rover and its German parent. ($1=.6004 Pound)
